title: An Audience in Gold
description: One Piglin Brute rules the designated Nether Village as its local Chieftain. Wear gold to earn enough restraint for an audience; this opens political contact, not submission.
description_completed: The designated Chieftain has heard the Overlord's claim. Contact with this village is established, but its final political state remains unsettled.

dialogue.offer: Gold buys you a moment, Overlord. Speak before the village decides your claim is worth less than the metal on your back.
dialogue.ready_to_turn_in: I have heard enough. This village knows your name now. Do not mistake an audience for obedience.
dialogue.completed: Your claim has been heard. What this village becomes under your reign has not yet been decided.

prerequisites.name: Establish the first foundation of the reign

rewards.name: Record formal audience with the designated Piglin Chieftain
